name: 目标公司
description: One row per target company: match evidence, drafted email, and outreach status

agentPrompts.label: Review a company and approve the send
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the company I name — its match evidence, drafted email, and the address it would send to — and if I approve it, write `status: queued` with the chosen `sent-to` address and `approved-at`. The human approves every send; never send on your own initiative.

agentPrompts.label: Edit and tailor a drafted email
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then revise the email subject and body for the company I name so the opening paragraph speaks to that company's specific evidence, keeping the rest consistent with my profile's highlights. Plain text only — no HTML, no tracking pixel.

agentPrompts.label: What's ready to send?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder, then list companies sorted the way the desk sorts them — evidence type (official-site above aggregator above business-match) first, match score only breaking ties — and show their status.

agentPrompts.label: Check evidence freshness before sending
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder, then flag companies whose evidence type is blank or whose evidence date is older than 30 days — both mean 未标注/check before sending, not that the role is confirmed open.
